title: WhiteHorse Finance, Inc. To Report First Quarter 2025 Financial Results
summary: WhiteHorse Finance, Inc. ("WhiteHorse Finance" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: WHF) today announced that it will release its first quarter financial results for the period ended March 31, 2025 on Monday, May 12, 2025. The Company will discuss its financial results on a conference call on Tuesday, May 13, 2025 at 4:30 p.m. ET. To access the teleconference, please dial 800-267-6316 (domestic) or +1 203-518-9783 (international) approximately 10 minutes before the teleconference's scheduled start time and reference ID #WHFQ125. Investors may also access the call on the investor relations portion of the Company's website at www.whitehorsefinance.com . If you are unable to access the live teleconference, a replay will be available beginning approximately two hours after the call's completion through May 20, 2025. The teleconference replay can be accessed by dialing 800-839-1246 or +1 402-220-0464 for international callers. A webcast replay will also be available on the investor relations portion
